timeline.summary: Mahendra Kumar Dhanuka, Promoter, declared no encumbrance on promoter and promoter group shares by April 3, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹483.34 Cr (+9.3% YoY), net profit ₹97.77 Cr (+29.5% YoY).
Dhanuka Agritech reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹483.34 Cr (+9.4% YoY) and PAT of ₹97.77 Cr (+29.5% YoY), proposing a ₹70 Cr buyback and ₹2/share dividend.
Dhanuka Agritech Limited shared the audio recording link for its Analysts/Investors Call on Audited Financial Results for Q4FY26 and FY26, held on May 19, 2026, approved by the Board.
On May 22, 2026; Dhanuka Agritech hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call
Dhanuka Agritech sets May 29 as record date for ₹70 Cr buyback at ₹1,400 per share
Sundae Capital submitted the Letter of Offer for Dhanuka Agritech's ₹70 Cr tender buyback at ₹1,400/share, running June 4–10, 2026.
On 14 October 2026, Dhanuka Agritech launched Tembotrax, a post-emergence herbicide for maize and sugarcane, in the domestic Indian market.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹657.51 Cr, net profit ₹109.22 Cr.
